name: efficiency
description: Records per repository, across sessions, where Claude Code wastes context or calls (MCP servers loaded but never called, failed and repeated calls, large results, compactions), and /efficiency ranks it with the exact settings file and key to change; on /efficiency only, opus adds up to 5 recommendations drawn from those fixes

enabled.title: Efficiency
enabled.description: Off: nothing is recorded and /efficiency is not added.

useModel.title: Model recommendations
useModel.description: On: /efficiency also asks the model for at most 5 recommendations, drawn only from the fixes it lists. Only when you run /efficiency, never in the background. Off: the code-built list alone.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model /efficiency asks: an alias or a full model id. Called through Claude Code, on the signed-in account.

timeoutSeconds.title: Model timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: The model call is given up after this long, and the code-built list is shown alone. 5 to 300.

largeResultChars.title: Large result (characters)
largeResultChars.description: A tool result of at least this many characters counts as large. 1000 to 1000000.

windowSessions.title: Sessions kept per repository
windowSessions.description: The latest this many sessions of each repository are kept and judged. 2 to 100.
